title: Global Networks Leader
description:
Purpose


As the Global Network Operations Leader, you will oversee the comprehensive management and direction of our network operations, ensuring optimal performance and reliability on a global scale. This critical role involves managing a managed service partner to deliver superior network operations and support services.


Main Responsibilities


Oversee the day-to-day network operations, including monitoring, maintenance, and incident response, to ensure high availability and performance.


Oversee the escalation process, ensuring timely resolution of critical network issues and minimizing impact on business operations.


Supervise routine maintenance activities, ensuring they are conducted efficiently and effectively to prevent unplanned downtime and extend the life of network assets.


Lead change management processes for network operations, including planning, approval, and implementation of network changes to ensure minimal disruption and adherence to best practices.


Act as the primary liaison with our managed service partner, ensuring they meet or exceed service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs).


Continuously assess and improve network performance, reliability, and security, leveraging data and analytics to drive decision-making.


Innovation and Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and technology enhancements, leading initiatives to implement innovative solutions.


Develop and implement risk management strategies to mitigate potential network disruptions and ensure business continuity.


Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, providing regular updates on network performance, issues, and improvements.


Ensure compliance with relevant Orbia infrastructure standards, regulations, and security protocols to protect the organization's network infrastructure. Take care of regular audits.


Knowledge and experience requiered


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • Language(s) and level of proficiency: English (fluent) and Spanish
  • In-depth knowledge of network infrastructure technologies, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and network monitoring tools.
  • Proficiency in network protocols, such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, and MPLS.
  • Experience with network security best practices and technologies, including VPNs, IDS/IPS, and network access control.
  • Familiarity with cloud networking and hybrid cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with deploying, configuring, and testing network equipment.
  • Familiarity with automation tools and scripting (e.g., Ansible, Python).


Management & communication Skills


  • Experience in managing relationships with MSP, vendors and suppliers.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders (e.g., operations, finance, senior management).


Relevant Experience


  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in network operations management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role overseeing global network operations.
  • Extensive experience working with and managing relationships with managed service partners.
  • Relevant certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent are highly desirable.
  • ITIL certification is a plus.

Atuar como referência técnica fundamental dentro da squad, focando na execução de tarefas de alta complexidade com autonomia e qualidade. Espera-se que este profissional garanta a estabilidade e a performance das aplicações Back-end (Node.js), dissemine boas práticas de engenharia (como Clean Code e SOLID) através de Code Reviews rigorosos e atue como mentor técnico para desenvolvedores de níveis Júnior e Pleno, elevando a barra técnica do time sem perder o foco na entrega de valor para o negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços escaláveis utilizando Node.js, TypeScript e arquitetura Serverless na AWS.
  • Realizar Code Reviews detalhados, garantindo a qualidade do código, segurança e a conformidade com os padrões arquiteturais definidos.
  • Escrever e manter testes automatizados (unitários e de integração) para garantir a confiabilidade das entregas.
  • Atuar na investigação e resolução de incidentes críticos em produção (troubleshooting), bem como na otimização de performance de rotinas e banco de dados (NoSQL).
  • Apoiar tecnicamente a gestão de produto na viabilidade de novos requisitos e colaborar na estimativa de esforço das tarefas da squad.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento back-end utilizando Node.js e TypeScript.
  • Domínio na construção de APIs RESTful e uso de frameworks como NestJS ou Express.
  • Vivência prática com arquitetura de microsserviços e mensageria (AWS SQS/SNS ou similares).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados NoSQL (MongoDB), incluindo modelagem e otimização de performance.
  • Conhecimento sólido em serviços da AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3).
  • Prática habitual de escrita de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração).
  • Habilidade com Git, fluxos de Code Review e ambientes de CI/CD.


Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Docker e orquestração (Kubernetes).
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ou Serverless Framework).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de observabilidade (Datadog, New Relic ou CloudWatch).
  • Vivência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL) ou caches (Redis).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança de aplicação (OWASP).

  • Regime: PJ + Benefícios.
  • Localização: 100% Remoto

title: Data Scientist
description:
We’re Hiring: Data Scientist | Remote (Brazil)

At Staffing Abroad , we are currently looking for a Data Scientist based in Brazil to join one of our international clients in a fast-growing, data-driven environment.

This role is ideal for professionals passionate about transforming complex data into strategic insights and building predictive models that drive business performance.


About the Role

The Data Scientist will support business decision-making through advanced analytics, machine learning, and predictive modeling.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing and deploying machine learning and AI-driven models
  • Forecasting revenue and optimizing sales and marketing performance
  • Developing dashboards and analytical insights for leadership teams
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams including Finance, Product, Marketing, and Operations
  • Translating complex datasets into actionable business recommendations

You will work with a modern data stack including Snowflake, Rivery, dbt, and Domo.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Science or Machine Learning roles
  • Strong Python skills (pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch)
  • Advanced SQL and cloud data warehouse experience
  • Experience building predictive models with measurable business impact
  • Strong analytical thinking and data storytelling skills
  • English Level C1

Nice to have:

  • Experience with LLMs or Generative AI
  • FinTech or SaaS experience
  • MLOps or model deployment experience

description:
HYBRID (1-2X WEEK IN SÃO PAULO CAPITAL - NEAR PAULISTA AVENUE)

FLUENT ENGLISH (B2+) REQUIRED


Knowledge, skills and experience required


  • Strong experience with TypeScript (Node.js & React) and excellent knowledge of JavaScript fundamentals.

title: Supervisor de vendas
description:
A Fugini é uma empresa brasileira de alimentos, líder nos segmentos de molhos de tomate e vegetais, que iniciou sua trajetória há quase 30 anos na cidade de Monte Alto, interior de São Paulo. Com atuação totalmente voltada ao mercado nacional, seus produtos estão presentes em todas as regiões do país. Atualmente, a companhia opera com duas unidades fabris equipadas com modernos sistemas de automação: uma em Monte Alto (SP) e outra em Cristalina (GO), inaugurada em 2010 e com 33 mil metros quadrados de área construída. Guiada pelos pilares de inovação, sustentabilidade, saudabilidade e excelência, a Fugini foi pioneira no lançamento de embalagens do tipo sachê para a linha de atomatados - uma das mais eficazes e seguras para a preservação dos alimentos - e a primeira no mundo a embalar vegetais nesse formato. Comprometida em oferecer produtos saudáveis e com rótulo limpo (clean label), a empresa não utiliza conservantes artificiais e promoveu a redução de sal, açúcar e gordura na maioria de suas formulações. Seu portfólio inclui molhos de tomate, vegetais em sachês e latas, molhos especiais, condimentos e outros itens desenvolvidos sob rigorosos padrões de qualidade e segurança alimentar. Para saber mais, acesse fugini.com.br.


O que buscamos:

✔Experiência sólida em indústria do segmento alimentar;

✔ Conhecimento amplo no atendimento de clientes do Varejo de pequeno e médio porte, grandes redes varejistas e clientes de atacado;

✔Supervisionar a equipe de Empresários Representantes Comerciais, garantindo o cumprimento dos objetivos;

✔Acompanhar o desempenho da equipe, oferecendo suporte e feedback contínuo;

✔Desenvolver estratégias comerciais para expansão de mercado e aumento da participação;

✔Realizar visitas a clientes estratégicos e acompanhar negociações importantes;

✔Monitorar concorrência e tendências de mercado para identificar oportunidades;

✔Assegurar o alinhamento da equipe com as políticas comerciais e de atendimento da empresa;

✔ Estruturação de equipes (montagem e desenvolvimento de equipes);

✔Importante ter atuado profissionalmente nos estados do Piauí e Maranhão;

✔Residir em Teresina/PI.


Principais desafios:

Monitorar performance de produtos e garantir execução no PDV;

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Technical Account Manager – Telecom Software


Iquall es una compañía de software especializada en automatización y transformación de redes para operadores de telecomunicaciones. Trabajamos con grandes carriers, ayudándolos a modernizar su operación, automatizar procesos críticos y evolucionar la gestión de la red hacia modelos más eficientes y autónomos. Somos una empresa con fuerte ADN técnico, pero con visión comercial y foco en crecimiento sostenible. Nuestro modelo combina coherencia comercial, credibilidad técnica y ejecución sólida.


Buscamos un Technical Account Manager (TAM) con fuerte perfil estratégico y orientación al cliente para gestionar cuentas clave (Tier-1) dentro del sector telecom. El TAM es responsable de gestionar integralmente la cuenta desde lo técnico-comercial. No es un rol de soporte ni de delivery operativo. Es quien entiende los desafíos del cliente, influye en su planificación futura y construye oportunidades sostenibles. El rol combina visión técnica, desarrollo de negocio y acompañamiento post-venta para asegurar la generación de valor continuo y la adopción de nuestras soluciones de automatización.


Principales Responsabilidades

Gestión Estratégica y Desarrollo de Negocio:

  • Comprender la estructura tecnológica, operativa y presupuestaria del cliente, alineando nuestras soluciones con sus iniciativas de transformación digital y eficiencia operativa.
  • Detectar iniciativas y problemas estructurales antes de que se conviertan en procesos formales de licitación (RFPs).
  • Generar proactivamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada (\"budget fishing\").
  • Influir en la planificación futura y las líneas presupuestarias del cliente.

Venta Consultiva (Soluciones Estándar):

  • Diseñar y presentar de forma autónoma propuestas técnico-comerciales cuando la solución se base en el portafolio existente de Iquall.
  • Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente.

Relacionamiento y Evangelización:

  • Construir vínculos sólidos y gestionar múltiples stakeholders dentro de organizaciones complejas, manteniendo credibilidad tanto frente a equipos de ingeniería/operativos como áreas ejecutivas (C-Level).
  • Orquestar workshops y sesiones ejecutivas (\"Overview Demos\") para mostrar el arte de lo posible e impulsar la adopción de nuevas funcionalidades.
  • Continuidad Post-Venta (Value Delivery):
  • Asegurar la correcta implementación y adopción de las soluciones vendidas.
  • Coordinar la transición hacia la ejecución junto a los Project Managers (PMs) y Delivery, identificando riesgos tempranos, pero sin gestionar la operación directamente.


Requisitos Excluyentes:

  • Experiencia: 5+ años en roles de gestión técnica de cuentas, consultoría técnica o ingeniería de ventas (Pre-Sales) con fuerte componente relacional y orientados a resultados comerciales.
  • Industria: Experiencia sólida trabajando con operadores de telecomunicaciones (Tier-1 preferentemente), conocimiento de operaciones, arquitectura de red (fija, móvi, Cloudl, ej. FTTH, 4G/5G), y plataformas OSS/BSS.
  • Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería (Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas, Electrónica) o carrera técnica equivalente.
  • Idiomas: Dominio fluido de inglés y español.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conocimiento conceptual de software, modelos de despliegue (Cloud, SaaS, On-premise), APIs e integración. Familiaridad con los marcos de trabajo de la industria (ej. estándares TM Forum, eTOM, Open APIs). Entendimiento suficiente para influir técnicamente sin necesidad de ejecutar configuraciones profundas (hands-on).

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Technical Account Manager – Telecom Software


Iquall es una compañía de software especializada en automatización y transformación de redes para operadores de telecomunicaciones. Trabajamos con grandes carriers, ayudándolos a modernizar su operación, automatizar procesos críticos y evolucionar la gestión de la red hacia modelos más eficientes y autónomos. Somos una empresa con fuerte ADN técnico, pero con visión comercial y foco en crecimiento sostenible. Nuestro modelo combina coherencia comercial, credibilidad técnica y ejecución sólida.


Buscamos un Technical Account Manager (TAM) con fuerte perfil estratégico y orientación al cliente para gestionar cuentas clave (Tier-1) dentro del sector telecom. El TAM es responsable de gestionar integralmente la cuenta desde lo técnico-comercial. No es un rol de soporte ni de delivery operativo. Es quien entiende los desafíos del cliente, influye en su planificación futura y construye oportunidades sostenibles. El rol combina visión técnica, desarrollo de negocio y acompañamiento post-venta para asegurar la generación de valor continuo y la adopción de nuestras soluciones de automatización.


Principales Responsabilidades

Gestión Estratégica y Desarrollo de Negocio:

  • Comprender la estructura tecnológica, operativa y presupuestaria del cliente, alineando nuestras soluciones con sus iniciativas de transformación digital y eficiencia operativa.
  • Detectar iniciativas y problemas estructurales antes de que se conviertan en procesos formales de licitación (RFPs).
  • Generar proactivamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada (\"budget fishing\").
  • Influir en la planificación futura y las líneas presupuestarias del cliente.

Venta Consultiva (Soluciones Estándar):

  • Diseñar y presentar de forma autónoma propuestas técnico-comerciales cuando la solución se base en el portafolio existente de Iquall.
  • Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente.

Relacionamiento y Evangelización:

  • Construir vínculos sólidos y gestionar múltiples stakeholders dentro de organizaciones complejas, manteniendo credibilidad tanto frente a equipos de ingeniería/operativos como áreas ejecutivas (C-Level).
  • Orquestar workshops y sesiones ejecutivas (\"Overview Demos\") para mostrar el arte de lo posible e impulsar la adopción de nuevas funcionalidades.
  • Continuidad Post-Venta (Value Delivery):
  • Asegurar la correcta implementación y adopción de las soluciones vendidas.
  • Coordinar la transición hacia la ejecución junto a los Project Managers (PMs) y Delivery, identificando riesgos tempranos, pero sin gestionar la operación directamente.


Requisitos Excluyentes:

  • Experiencia: 5+ años en roles de gestión técnica de cuentas, consultoría técnica o ingeniería de ventas (Pre-Sales) con fuerte componente relacional y orientados a resultados comerciales.
  • Industria: Experiencia sólida trabajando con operadores de telecomunicaciones (Tier-1 preferentemente), conocimiento de operaciones, arquitectura de red (fija, móvi, Cloudl, ej. FTTH, 4G/5G), y plataformas OSS/BSS.
  • Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería (Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas, Electrónica) o carrera técnica equivalente.
  • Idiomas: Dominio fluido de inglés y español.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conocimiento conceptual de software, modelos de despliegue (Cloud, SaaS, On-premise), APIs e integración. Familiaridad con los marcos de trabajo de la industria (ej. estándares TM Forum, eTOM, Open APIs). Entendimiento suficiente para influir técnicamente sin necesidad de ejecutar configuraciones profundas (hands-on).
  • Competencias: Comunicación técnica a nivel ejecutivo, capacidad para traducir problemas operativos en impacto de negocio, pensamiento estratégico a largo plazo y excelentes habilidades de negociación.
  • Disponibilidad: Para viajar atendiendo el territorio asignado.


Deseable

  • Formación de posgrado en gestión tecnológica o negocios.

  • Espacio para crecer profesionalmente combinando tecnología de alto nivel y negocio.

title: Analista de Homologação de Produto

Essa posição tem papel estratégico na expansão e desenvolvimento da base de fornecedores da empresa, sendo responsável por identificar oportunidades no mercado, conduzir negociações e garantir a entrada de parceiros alinhados aos padrões de custo, capacidade operacional e experiência definidos.

A pessoa será responsável por conduzir avaliações técnicas, comerciais e operacionais, assegurando a consistência, escalabilidade e performance dos fornecedores homologados, sempre com foco na melhor experiência para o cliente.

• Identificar, registrar e acompanhar inconsistências, atuando junto às áreas responsáveis

• Assegurar cumprimento de SLAs, NPS, prazos e condições acordadas em contrato

• Documentar evidências, relatórios e resultados de validação

• validar e autorizar a liberação final de fornecedores e produtos para operação

Objetivo do cargo

Garantir uma base de fornecedores homologados competitiva, escalável e regionalmente eficiente, assegurando qualidade, consistência e excelência nas entregas, além de contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da experiência do cliente.

Requisitos:

• Capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes

• Experiência com testes manuais, validação e documentação de processos

• Boa comunicação para interação com áreas técnicas e de negócio

• Organização e disciplina para gestão de múltiplas demandas

• Vivência com avaliação de fornecedores, operações ou processos de compras (diferencial forte)

Diferenciais

• Vivência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Trello, etc.)

• Experiência em operações, eventos ou gestão de fornecedores

• Noções de análise de dados ou indicadores (NPS, SLA, performance)

title: Shopify Account Manager | Remote Full-Time
description:
About Step Labs

Step Labs is a web design and development agency specializing in revenue growth for 7- and 8-figure e-commerce brands. We partner with ambitious founders to help them scale efficiently through research-driven experimentation and CRO-focused split testing.


Our custom revenue growth systems are built to deliver measurable results — typically achieving a 30% increase in revenue within 90 days through weekly optimizations and data-backed design enhancements.


We’re a remote-first, high-performance team of strategists, designers, and developers united by a shared mission: to build online experiences that convert curiosity into customers.


Role Overview

We’re looking for a Shopify Account Manager to join our growing team.


In this role, you will serve as the main point of contact for our clients — managing relationships, guiding strategy, and ensuring flawless execution of e-commerce initiatives.

You’ll work closely with our design, development, and CRO teams to plan, implement, and optimize Shopify storefronts that deliver tangible business results.


This position is fully remote and ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, communicates clearly, and has a deep understanding of Shopify and e-commerce growth mechanics.


Key Responsibilities
  • Act as the primary liaison between Step Labs and assigned clients, ensuring strong communication and satisfaction throughout every project phase.
  • Develop strategic roadmaps tailored to each client’s growth goals — including CRO experiments, A/B testing, and ongoing Shopify optimizations.
  • Coordinate with internal teams (design, development, strategy) to ensure timely and high-quality project delivery.
  • Oversee new Shopify store builds, redesigns, migrations, and CRO-focused updates.
  • Monitor store performance metrics (conversion rate, AOV, LTV, revenue per visitor, etc.) and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Lead client calls, presentations, and reporting sessions — clearly articulating progress, results, and next steps.
  • Identify opportunities for account growth through strategic recommendations and data-driven insights.
  • Maintain accurate records of communications, deliverables, and KPIs using project management tools (ClickUp, Notion, or similar).
  • Collaborate with leadership to continuously refine Step Labs’ account management processes and playbooks.


Qualifications
  • Proven experience managing Shopify-based e-commerce accounts or projects.
  • Strong grasp of e-commerce strategy, analytics, and key performance metrics.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills — ability to manage multiple accounts simultaneously.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication in English (fluent/native-level proficiency required).
  • Ability to interpret analytics and translate data into clear strategic actions.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote, high-autonomy environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Prior experience within an e-commerce agency or similar high-growth environment is a strong plus


What We Offer
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Fully remote work with flexible hours.
  • Opportunity to work directly with global 7- and 8-figure e-commerce brands.
  • Fast-paced, collaborative culture with high-impact projects.
  • Professional growth and leadership opportunities within a rapidly scaling agency.

title: DevOps (Jr/Pl)
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!

São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!

Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa DevOps (Jr/Pl) para se unir ao nosso Time de Operations para:

  • Atuar de forma autônoma na implementação e sustentação técnica de sistemas em ambiente produtivo, realizando análises, troubleshooting e resolução de incidentes;
  • Executar e acompanhar mudanças controladas (change requests), garantindo avaliação de impacto e estabilidade dos serviços;
  • Investigar causa raiz de falhas, analisando logs, integrações e comportamento das aplicações;
  • Gerenciar demandas via Jira, acompanhando fluxo até a resolução e garantindo comunicação com as áreas envolvidas;
  • Realizar suporte técnico ao cliente em cenários de falha ou implantação, conduzindo alinhamentos quando necessário documentar.


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Experiência com suporte e sustentação de sistemas em ambiente produtivo;
  • Experiência com troubleshooting e investigação de causa raiz;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de chamados/demandas (ex.: Jira);
  • Experiência em implantação técnica e validação pós-implementação em ambiente produtivo;
  • Vivência com gestão e execução de change requests, incluindo análise de impacto;
  • Conhecimento em Linux para troubleshooting (serviços, portas, processos e logs);
  • Conhecimento operacional em Docker e Kong para análise e suporte de aplicações (não administração de infraestrutura);
  • Capacidade de redigir documentação técnica e atendimentos de forma estruturada;
  • Espanhol intermediário para comunicação operacional.


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Experiência com análise de logs e integrações entre sistemas;
  • Experiência com ambientes críticos ou de alta disponibilidade;
  • Vivência em atendimento a clientes ou suporte técnico B2B;
  • Noções de redes, certificados digitais e comunicação entre serviços;
  • Conhecimento com produtos, ou com os conceitos relacionados com meios de pagamento.


O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;

title: Global Networks Leader
description:
Purpose


As the Global Network Operations Leader, you will oversee the comprehensive management and direction of our network operations, ensuring optimal performance and reliability on a global scale. This critical role involves managing a managed service partner to deliver superior network operations and support services.


Main Responsibilities


Oversee the day-to-day network operations, including monitoring, maintenance, and incident response, to ensure high availability and performance.


Oversee the escalation process, ensuring timely resolution of critical network issues and minimizing impact on business operations.


Supervise routine maintenance activities, ensuring they are conducted efficiently and effectively to prevent unplanned downtime and extend the life of network assets.


Lead change management processes for network operations, including planning, approval, and implementation of network changes to ensure minimal disruption and adherence to best practices.


Act as the primary liaison with our managed service partner, ensuring they meet or exceed service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs).


Continuously assess and improve network performance, reliability, and security, leveraging data and analytics to drive decision-making.


Innovation and Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and technology enhancements, leading initiatives to implement innovative solutions.

title: Product Designer
description:
At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.


About The Opportunity


We are looking for a Product Designer to join a fast-paced, product-driven environment focused on building innovative digital experiences in the data and financial technology space.

In this role, you will design end-to-end product experiences for a platform that redefines how users interact with and manage their data.   • Ensure consistency, usability, and high-quality visual design across all touchpoints.
  • Support the creation of marketing and web assets aligned with brand guidelines.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong experience in Product Design with a portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product work.
  • Proficiency in Figma for design, prototyping, and developer handoff.
  • Ability to simplify complex systems and concepts into intuitive user experiences.
  • Hands-on experience with user research, discovery, and validation methods.
  • Experience building and evolving Design Systems in collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Ability to work independently in high-ambiguity, fast-paced environments.
  • Strong collaboration skills and a user-centered mindset.
  • Experience using tools such as user journey mapping, flow diagrams, and prototyping techniques.
  • Understanding of different levels of design fidelity, from low-fidelity concepts to production-ready designs.
  • Advanced to Fluent level of English (mandatory).


Nice To Have Skills


  • Experience with Webflow or Framer for marketing or institutional websites.
  • Background in AI, privacy, or data-related products.
  • Experience designing native mobile applications (iOS and Android).
  • Experience working on products in early-stage or product-market fit environments.


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Clinical Research Associate - Biotech
description:
Clinical Research Associate (CRA II) – Oncology

São Paulo

Full-time | ✈️ Travel required

The Role

We are seeking a Clinical Research Associate (CRA II) with at least 1 year of on-site monitoring experience in oncology to support the successful delivery of clinical trials. In this role, you will be responsible for site monitoring, compliance, and data quality, playing a critical role in bringing innovative therapies to patients.

You will work closely with investigative sites and cross-functional project teams to ensure studies are conducted in accordance with GCP, ICH guidelines, regulatory requirements, and study protocols .

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform site selection, initiation, monitoring, and close-out visits in line with the contracted scope of work
  • Ensure compliance with GCP, ICH, regulatory requirements, and study protocols
  • Partner with site staff to support and track patient recruitment and enrollment strategies
  • Deliver protocol and study-specific training to site personnel
  • Assess site performance, identify quality risks, and escalate issues proactively
  • Monitor study progress, including regulatory documentation, enrollment, CRF completion, and query resolution
  • Ensure accurate and complete maintenance of TMF and ISF documentation
  • Document monitoring activities through detailed visit reports, follow-ups, and correspondence
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support overall study execution and timelines
  • Where applicable, support site-level recruitment planning and financial activities , including invoice tracking

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or a health-related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Minimum 1 year of on-site monitoring experience , preferably in oncology
  • Strong working knowledge of GCP, ICH guidelines, and regulatory requirements
  • Excellent communication, organisation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability and willingness to travel as required

Why apply?

  • Work on oncology-focused clinical trials with meaningful patient impact
  • Join a biotech-focused CRO environment known for agility and scientific alignment
  • Gain exposure to high-quality studies and collaborative project teams
  • Continue developing your CRA career within complex and innovative trials

title: Production Support Analyst
description:
Hello,


Please review the JD below and let me know if you're interested in an updated resume


Production Support Analyst

São Paulo, Brazil - Onsite

12+ Months Contract


Job Description

The role involves close interaction with trading and business users, managing their requests, ensuring timely incident resolution, and providing deep functional and technical expertise. We are seeking a Fixed Income & Rates Technology Specialist with skills spanning Production Support,


QA Testing, and L2 Engineering. The role supports mission-critical platforms, including:

  • Fixed Income Trading Systems: Swaps, Bonds (Credit and Govies), Inflation-linked.
  • Portfolio Management Platforms (risk & pricing)
  • QA testing


The main responsibility is to provide production support during Latam trading hours. The successful candidates are expected to help with QA testing and L2 Engineering when not engaged with production support tasks.

Key Responsibilities

1. Production Support

  • Support Fixed Income products: Bonds (Credit/Govies), Inflation-linked instruments, and Swaps.
  • Provide both functional and technical guidance to trading and business users, including incident ownership and resolution.
  • Participate in problem management to address recurring issues and drive long-term fixes.
  • Document incidents, requests, and solutions to enhance the knowledge database.

2. QA Testing & L2 Engineering

  • Perform functional, non-functional, and regression testing for Fixed Income trading platforms. Execute E2E, and integration tests.
  • Manage test cases and defects.
  • Identify, document, and track defects in Jira while collaborating with developers for resolution.
  • Assist throughout the application lifecycle, including project delivery and testing.
  • Depending on the candidate’s background: Implement minor enhancements and bug fixes. Develop monitoring and alerting solutions to proactively identify system issues.


Required Skills & Experience

Front Office trading systems experience preferred. Strong English; Spanish a plus.

1) Front Office Problem-Solving & Trader Support:

  • Rapid incident triage and business impact assessment during live trading
  • Root cause analysis across trade lifecycles (capture → booking → settlement)
  • Clear communication with traders under pressure; translating technical issues to business terms
  • Developing workarounds to maintain trading operations while issues are resolved

2) Financial Markets Domain Knowledge:

  • Bonds, Swaps, Futures, Credit, Govies, Inflation-linked instruments
  • eTrading and OTC workflows
  • Market data feeds
  • Pricing & risk analytics (PnL, sensitivities)

3) Testing & Validation:

  • Pre-market system and market data feed validation
  • Trade testing across Fixed Income products with P&L and risk sensitivity validation
  • Regression testing and UAT coordination with trading desks
  • Test case design based on real trading scenarios and edge cases


The ideal candidate would also know some of the following areas:

1) Incident & Test Management Tools:

  • Jira (ticket management, workflow tracking)
  • X-ray or similar test management tools (basic test case execution)

2) Technical Skills (familiarity with one or more):

  • Scripting: Basic SQL queries, simple Bash or PowerShell scripts for log analysis
  • Programming: Exposure to Python, Java, or JavaScript (able to read code and understand stack traces)
  • Log Analysis: Ability to parse application logs and identify error patterns. (Kibana or similar)

3) Infrastructure & Platform Awareness:

  • Basic understanding of cloud concepts (AWS services like Lambda, S3, EFS)
  • Familiarity with microservices architecture and RESTful APIs
  • Understanding of message queuing systems (e.g., Kafka, MQ, SNS/SQS)
  • Database basics: ability to query relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, DocumentDB)

4) Desirable but Not Required:

  • Experience with monitoring tools (Splunk, CloudWatch, Grafana, Dynatrace)
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines
  • Exposure to caching technologies (Redis, Memcached)

title: Applications Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

  • JavaScript

title: Tax/Finance Supervisor
description:
Position: Tax/Finance Supervisor

Location: São Paulo/SP – On-site


Responsibilities

Professional with a solid career in the areas of tax, finance, and accounting, with experience in multinational companies and shared services environments. Extensive experience in direct and indirect tax management, compliance, tax planning, and team leadership. Fluent English is required for daily meetings with the company’s headquarters (China).


Technical Skills

  • Tax Management: DAS, ICMS, ICMS-ST, ISS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, IRPJ/CSLL, INSS, IRRF, and CPP.
  • Ancillary Obligations: Preparation, review, and submission of SPED Fiscal, GIA, GIA-ST, EFD Contributions, DCTF, PER/COMP, STDA, DMED, DIRF, ECF, among others.
  • Compliance and Audits: Handling internal and external audits, as well as federal, state, and municipal inspections, with a focus on risk mitigation.
  • Tax Planning: Monitoring of special tax regimes in various states, analysis of tax opportunities, and reduction of the tax burden.
  • ERP and Systems: Implementation and configuration of tax modules.
  • Tax Legislation: Reading and interpreting regulations related to ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, IR, and other taxes.


Experience and Results

  • Reorganization of the tax and financial operational controls area , implementing improvements and conducting operational risk and compliance assessments.
  • Leading budget and tax planning projects , resulting in a significant reduction in the tax burden.
  • Responsible for strategic meetings and reports directly with the international headquarters (China). Fluent English is required; Mandarin is a plus.
  • Dynamic and participatory leadership in team management, including hiring, onboarding, and training.
  • Effective performance in reviewing ECF , calculating taxes on revenue and services, intercompany transactions, and filing supplementary tax returns.


Behavioral Competencies

  • Collaborative, dynamic leadership profile with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Strong negotiation skills, clear communication, and adaptability to new environments and roles.


About us

Blinq Tecnologia is a start-up company operating in the smartphone market with a focus on providing superior and affordable experiences for younger audiences. We have been operating in partnership with realme since 2018, the fastest-growing smartphone brand in the world, active in 61 markets globally, including China, India, Southeast Asia, Europe, Latin America, the Middle East, and Africa, with a total of more than 300 million users around the globe.


If you meet the criteria and want to be part of this story, send us your CV!

title: Arquitetura de Segurança Cloud AWS - 132141
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com (Segurança/AWS).

Responsabilidades:

Arquiteto especializado em segurança para ambientes financeiros críticos, responsável por definir, validar e garantir controles de segurança fim a fim para cargas de trabalho relacionadas ao PIX na AWS, incluindo integração híbrida com ambientes on-premises, HSM e requisitos regulatórios. Realização de comprovações (POCs) para migração de workloads PIX do mainframe para AWS.

  • Definir arquitetura de segurança alinhada ao AWS Well-Architected Framework (Pilar de Segurança);
  • Projetar estratégia de IAM (federação, RBAC, privilégio mínimo);
  • Definir estratégia de criptografia (em trânsito e em repouso);
  • Integrar soluções HSM (on-prem e cloud);
  • Garantir conformidade com requisitos do BACEN e LGPD;
  • Definir padrões de segurança para containers (EKS/ROSA);
  • Implementar estratégia de segurança multi-conta e landing zone;
  • Conduzir modelagem de ameaças e avaliações de risco;
  • Apoiar POCs com validação de segurança e verificações de conformidade.

  • AWS IAM, AWS KMS, AWS CloudHSM;
  • Criptografia (PKI, TLS, assinaturas digitais);
  • Segurança de APIs (OAuth2, OpenID Connect);

  • Auditoria e logging (CloudTrail, GuardDuty);

title: Front Office Production Support Engineer (Fixed Income Trading Systems)
description:
Role: Front Office Production Support Engineer (Fixed Income Trading Systems)

Location: Sao Paulo,Brazil(Onsite)

Type: Contract


Job Description

The role involves close interaction with trading and business users, managing their requests, ensuring timely incident resolution, and providing deep functional and technical expertise. We are seeking a Fixed Income & Rates Technology Specialist with skills spanning Production Support, QA Testing, and L2 Engineering. The role supports mission critical platforms including:

• Fixed Income Trading Systems: Swaps, Bonds (Credit and Govies), Inflation-linked.

• Portfolio Management Platforms (risk & pricing)

• QA testing

The main responsibility is to provide production support during Latam trading hours. The successful candidates are expected to help with QA testing and L2 Engineering when not engaged with production support tasks.

Key Responsibilities

1. Production Support

· Support Fixed Income products: Bonds (Credit/Govies), Inflation-linked instruments, and Swaps.

· Provide both functional and technical guidance to trading and business users, including incident ownership and resolution.

· Participate in problem management to address recurring issues and drive long-term fixes.

· Document incidents, requests, and solutions to enhance the knowledge database.

2. QA Testing & L2 Engineering

· Perform functional, non-functional, and regression testing for Fixed Income trading platforms. Execute E2E, and integration tests.

· Manage test cases and defects.

· Identify, document, and track defects in Jira while collaborating with developers for resolution.

· Assist throughout the application lifecycle, including project delivery and testing.

· Depending on the candidate’s background: Implement minor enhancements and bug fixes. Develop monitoring and alerting solutions to proactively identify system issues.


Required Skills & Experience

Front Office trading systems experience preferred. Strong English; Spanish a plus.

1) Front Office Problem-Solving & Trader Support:

· Rapid incident triage and business impact assessment during live trading

· Root cause analysis across trade lifecycles (capture → booking → settlement)

· Clear communication with traders under pressure; translating technical issues to business terms

· Developing workarounds to maintain trading operations while issues are resolved

2) Financial Markets Domain Knowledge:

· Bonds, Swaps, Futures, Credit, Govies, Inflation-linked instruments

· eTrading and OTC workflows

· Market data feeds

· Pricing & risk analytics (PnL, sensitivities)

3) Testing & Validation:

· Pre-market system and market data feed validation

· Trade testing across Fixed Income products with P&L and risk sensitivity validation

· Regression testing and UAT coordination with trading desks

· Test case design based on real trading scenarios and edge cases


The ideal candidate would also have knowledge in some of the following areas:

1) Incident & Test Management Tools:

· Jira (ticket management, workflow tracking)

· Xray or similar test management tools (basic test case execution)

2) Technical Skills (familiarity with one or more):

· Scripting: Basic SQL queries, simple Bash or PowerShell scripts for log analysis

· Programming: Exposure to Python, Java, or JavaScript (able to read code and understand stack traces)

· Log Analysis: Ability to parse application logs and identify error patterns. (Kibana or similar)

3) Infrastructure & Platform Awareness:

· Basic understanding of cloud concepts (AWS services like Lambda, S3, EFS)
